question: How is the emergence of desire characterized in relation to delight in one's own nature?
premises: This emergence is linked to one's own nature.
It is described as devoid of release in the delight of one's own nature.
inference: The emergence of desire is marked as lacking release in the delight of one's own nature.
uncertainties: The compound chain is dense; the exact nuance of nirmukti-rahita is interpretive.
plain_english: It is the emergence of the arising of desire, devoid of release in the delight of one's own nature.
